name: 4577-longprompt-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat. Ungated on the Hub, ~30 GB of bf16 safetensors, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, MLA (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64), MoE 64 routed + 2 shared experts top-6, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 240 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 4000 prompt and 128 output tokens, both fixed (stdev 0), seed 42.
purpose: A document analysis assistant handling 4000-token single-turn requests one at a time on a single H100.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at commit 49420741746c8f3e80e0eb17e7d012bfaf25793a
#   (`git describe --tags` = v0.4.4.post1-84-g49420741746).
#
# Flat `key: value` only. A nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the engine then runs
# without the mechanism this file declares.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration and modeling modules.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

disable-radix-cache: true

# 8192 is the engine's own default on an 80 GB card, and it admits the 4000-token prompt whole.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

# The longest request here is 4000 + 128 = 4128, so nothing is truncated; the checkpoint advertises
# 163840 positions and the engine sizes device-side per-request tables from that number.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
